description: This file contains implementation of test classes and functions for the quic test server, including custom session classes, dispatcher, and test server setup.

classes.name: CustomStreamSession
classes.description: A custom server session class that creates streams using provided factories and manages crypto streams.

classes.name: QuicTestDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class for creating and managing QUIC server sessions with support for custom stream and session factories.

classes.name: QuicTestServer
classes.description: A test QUIC server class that sets up dispatcher and session factories, and manages test sessions.

classes.name: ImmediateGoAwaySession
classes.description: A test session that immediately sends a GOAWAY frame upon certain events.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates an incoming stream, possibly using a factory.

methods.name: CreateQuicCryptoServerStream
methods.description: Creates a crypto stream, possibly using a factory.

methods.name: CreateQuicSession
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC session, using custom or default session classes.

methods.name: SetSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the session factory for the dispatcher.

methods.name: SetStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets the stream factory for the dispatcher.

methods.name: SetCryptoStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets the crypto stream factory for the dispatcher.

methods.name: CreateQuicDispatcher
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QUIC dispatcher instance.

methods.name: SetSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the session factory in the server.

methods.name: SetSpdyStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets the SPDY stream factory in the server.

methods.name: SetCryptoStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets the crypto stream factory in the server.

methods.name: SetEventLoopFactory
methods.description: Sets the event loop factory in the server.

methods.name: CreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates a new event loop, using custom or default factory.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames, sending GOAWAY if needed.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming crypto frames, sending GOAWAY if needed.

methods.name: OnNewEncryptionKeyAvailable
methods.description: Handles new encryption keys, sending GOAWAY if conditions are met.
